# elves_scim_user_rule (Resource)

Includes or excludes one rule for a list of SCIM users, matched by email. A user's rules apply to every Mac whose primary user is that user, while the user is active. They are applied after the Mac's configuration and SCIM group rules, and before rules set on the Mac itself. Only the listed users are managed: other users that have the same rule (set in the UI or by another resource) are left alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Allow Wireshark for a few people only
resource "elves_scim_user_rule" "wireshark_users" {
  rule_id = elves_rule.wireshark.id
  action  = "include"
  users = [
    "jane.doe@example.com",
    "john.roe@example.com",
  ]
}

# Lift a rule these users get from their configuration or a group
resource "elves_scim_user_rule" "no_block_for_admins" {
  rule_id = elves_rule.blocked_tool.id
  action  = "exclude"
  users   = ["it.admin@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (Number) Required. ID of the rule to assign, for example `elves_rule.example.id`. Changing it replaces the assignment.
- `users` (Set of String) Required. Emails of the SCIM users, as provisioned from your identity provider. Matched against the user's email or user name, ignoring case. Every user must exist in Elves.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Optional. `include` adds the rule. `exclude` takes it away when an earlier level adds it: rules are applied as default rules, then the configuration, then SCIM groups, then the SCIM user, then the Mac itself. Defaults to `include`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the assignment, `<rule_id>/<action>`. Used for import, which brings in every user that has the rule with that action.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <rule_id>/<action>. Every user that has the rule with that action
# is imported; remove the ones you don't want Terraform to manage afterwards.
terraform import elves_scim_user_rule.example 68/include
```
